The '''UR-40M patrol speeder''' was a model used on [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]] around the time of the [[Old Sith Wars]]. Created by [[Ubrikkian Repulsorlift Manufacturing]], it could achieve 800 kilometers per hour. It required one pilot, carried seven passengers plus sixty kilograms of cargo, and had a gunner-operated [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. A new vehicle cost 55,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but a used one only cost 30,000.
